items.q: Is the prototype really free? What's the catch?
items.a: There's no catch. The prototype is how we show that we understand your task. You see your website before paying, and we get a chance to win you over. One prototype per company, after a short call.

items.q: What if I don't like the prototype? Do I owe you anything?
items.a: No, nothing. Tell us what's wrong — we'll fix it, or we simply part as friends. No invoices, no obligations.

items.q: Why 50% prepayment after the prototype?
items.a: After the prototype the full work starts: designing all pages, code, integrations. The prepayment secures the agreement for both sides. You pay the rest after launch, once you've checked everything.

items.q: How much will my website cost?
items.a: Landing pages, business websites and online stores have fixed prices — see the Prices section. Catalogs, automation and bots are priced per task. The price goes into the contract and doesn't change.

items.q: How long from brief to launch?
items.a: Prototype — 48–72 hours. Then: a landing page from 3 business days, a business website from 7, an online store from 14. The exact deadline goes into the contract.

items.q: Why so affordable if it's hand-written code?
items.a: We have a well-tuned process: clear stages, proven solutions for typical tasks and no unnecessary approvals. You pay for the result, not for hours of meetings.

items.q: How do I pay?
items.a: Bank transfer under a contract. 50% after the prototype, the rest after launch.

items.q: Who owns the website — code, domain, access?
items.a: You do. The domain is registered in your name, and we hand over all access and the code. You can move to another contractor at any time — no buyouts, no hostages.

items.q: What happens after the 1-year warranty?
items.a: The website keeps working. You renew hosting and domain yourself or with us. If you need edits or support, we agree separately — no mandatory subscription.

items.q: What if you miss the deadline?
items.a: The deadline goes into the contract together with the price. If a delay is our fault, our liability is written into the contract too.

items.q: Do you guarantee #1 on Google?
items.a: Honestly — no, and you shouldn't trust anyone who promises that. We guarantee a technically sound website: fast, well-structured, with analytics set up. That's the foundation any promotion needs.

items.q: What if I don't know exactly what I need?
items.a: That's normal. Come with one idea — we'll figure it out together at the brief and suggest what fits you.

items.q: Can we start without texts and photos?
items.a: Yes. We write the copy from your brief and pick stock photos or suggest what to shoot. You can replace them later in the admin panel.

items.q: What if I don't like the design?
items.a: That's why we start with a moodboard and 2 screens. You approve the style before we design the whole site. Revisions at this stage are included.

items.q: How are you different from website builders (Tilda, Wix)?
items.a: A coded website is faster, ranks better on Google and isn't tied to a platform with a monthly fee. And most importantly — you don't have to build it yourself.

items.q: Do you work only in Ukraine or abroad too?
items.a: Across Ukraine and abroad. All communication is online: calls, messengers, email.

items.q: Can I edit the website myself?
items.a: Yes. In packages with an admin panel you change texts, prices and photos yourself. After launch we'll show you how — even from your phone.

items.q: What if I need a new page in six months?
items.a: Message us — we'll estimate and build it. Price and timeline are agreed before we start.

items.q: What's the difference between a landing page and a full website?
items.a: A landing page is one page for one offer, e.g. an ad campaign. A website is several pages about your whole business, with an admin panel and a structure Google understands.

items.q: Which integrations can you connect?
items.a: Telegram, CRM, online payments, delivery services, Google Sheets, 1C and other services with an API. Tell us what you use — we'll advise.
